design_philosophy.core_concept: A vibrant, mystical celebration of life and food. The site should feel like entering a high-end Día de los Muertos festival at midnight—mysterious, colorful, and deeply welcoming.

accents.usage: Price tags, specialized badges, decorative numbers

content_strategy.voice: Spirited, welcoming, and slightly mischievous (like La Catrina herself). Use phrases like 'Tacos to die for', 'Spirits high', 'Taste the tradition'.

sections.name: Hero
sections.type: Full-screen video/image background with centered typography. Two massive buttons: 'ORDER ONLINE' (Primary) and 'JOIN WAITLIST' (Secondary/Outline).

sections.name: About
sections.type: Split layout. Left: 'Catrina Art' image. Right: Story text about Independence, MO location and authentic recipes.

sections.name: Menu Preview
sections.type: Tabbed Interface (Tacos, Entrees, Drinks). Cards with no borders, just generous spacing and big typography.

sections.name: Waitlist/Reservation
sections.type: A dedicated 'Golden Ticket' section. Darker background. Simple form fields. 'Get in line before you arrive'.

sections.name: Reviews
sections.type: Horizontal scrolling marquee of 5-star badges and quotes.

sections.name: Location
sections.type: Full-width map with a custom dark skin overlay. Contact info in a floating glass card.

instructions_to_main_agent.2: Override the default Shadcn 'slate' colors with the custom 'Warm Brown/Obsidian' palette in tailwind.config.js.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Use the 'Sancreek' font for ALL headings. Use 'DM Sans' for body.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The 'Waitlist' form MUST submit to the backend. Use a mock function if backend is not ready, but UI must be functional.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Implement the 'Grain Overlay' on the body to give it a cinematic film look.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Ensure the 'Order Online' button is the most prominent element on the page (Marigold Orange).
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards. Use the custom 'menu_item' card style defined in components.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: For the Chatbot: Use a floating button in the bottom-right. When opened, it should have a 'Day of the Dead' skull icon as the avatar.
instructions_to_main_agent.9: Gallery: Use a Masonry layout (Bento grid) for the images.
instructions_to_main_agent.10: Map: Use a grayscale or dark mode filter on the Google Maps embed if possible, or place it in a container with a dark overlay that fades out on hover.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid dark colors with noise textures.
Spacing should be generous (py-24 or py-32 for sections).
All interactive elements must have a hover state that changes color or scale.
Use 'data-testid' for all buttons and inputs.
Ensure high contrast for text (Cream on Dark Brown).
